~Blood Vim~.Effect: Every turn, you have an extra 1 {A}Action Point.
~Blood Vim~.Notes: ...or Action if you somehow got this as a pet.
~Blood Vim~.Name: ~Blood Vim~

~Hunger Claws~.Effect: The Lycanthrope Animal Attacks Heal for 50% of the Damage rolled. However, for each 1 {A}Action Point spent not Animal Attacking, the Lycanthrope takes 5 True Damage.
~Hunger Claws~.Name: ~Hunger Claws~

~Ominous Howl~.Effect: All Units that can hear you become Feared.
~Ominous Howl~.Notes: A Feared Unit can only do one Act on its turn (e.g. move, make one attack, use one Ability, etc).
~Ominous Howl~.Name: ~Ominous Howl~

~Shield Bash~.Effect: If you roll 6 on the Pet Attack die, the target must pass a Might Check against 500% of your ^Your Initiative^ or be Single-Stunned and pushed 3 meters away.
~Shield Bash~.Notes:
Requires to be next to the target.
A Single-Stunned Unit has -1 Action Point on its (next) Turn.
~Shield Bash~.Name: ~Shield Bash~

~Routing Squire~.Effect: When the Squire comes within 1 meter of a Worhty Enemy, it gains 3 Shielding. Then it can't gain the Shielding from the same Enemy for the rest of the combat.
~Routing Squire~.Name: ~Routing Squire~

~Quickfoot~.Effect: Has 6 Movement Speed and can Break its Movement.
~Quickfoot~.Name: ~Quickfoot~

~Backstab~.Effect: The Squire's Flank Attacks deal an extra 1d4 Damage.
~Backstab~.Name: ~Backstab~

~Camouflage~.Effect: The Squire becomes effectively invisible to Units more 3 or more meters away from it.
~Camouflage~.Name: ~Camouflage~

~Magic Attack~.Effect: Pet Attack has 5 meter range and the Damage type can be Fire, Cold or Shock.
~Magic Attack~.Name: ~Magic Attack~

~Spellcasting~.Effect: Using its Action, the Squire can cast any Basic Ability up to Level 5 from the Elemental, Arcane or Mysticism schools that cost no {Mana}Mana and deals no Damage. The Squire can cast such Abilities a total of 3 times per Adventure, irrespective of those Abilities' Cooldowns.
~Spellcasting~.Name: ~Spellcasting~

~Blinding Light~.Name: ~Blinding Light~
~Blinding Light~.Notes: A Blind Unit's next Damage/Heal Act deals -50% Damage/Healing.

~Freedom~.Range: Use when an Ally becomes affected by a Control Effect. Remove that Control Effects from it.
~Freedom~.Notes:
Doesn't work for area persistent Control Effect like Hard Terrain, fog-like effects, etc.
Moving 1 meter through Hard Terrain takes 2 meters of Movement.
~Freedom~.Name: ~Freedom~

~Inflict Fear~.Effect: Any number of chosen Units the Old God can see become Feared.
~Inflict Fear~.Upgrade: _Upon inflicting fear, the curse given must be taken from energy elsewhere, and a random place on the planet becomes corrupted with strange energy and radiation, inflicting mental illness and mutating the flora and fauna around it._
~Inflict Fear~.Name: ~Inflict Fear~

~Inflict Unmaking~.Effect: Any number of chosen Units the Old God can see take Damage equal to 10% of their Max Health.
~Inflict Unmaking~.Upgrade: _Upon inflicting unmaking, a natural disaster occurs somewhere on the planet - a tidal wave, earthquake or plague takes place._
~Inflict Unmaking~.Name: ~Inflict Unmaking~

~Inflict Rapture~.Effect: A Unit the Old God can see takes 1d100 Damage and becomes permanently cursed, haunted by voices of evil, paranoia, night terrors and generalized anxiety.
~Inflict Rapture~.Upgrade: _Upon inflicting rapture, a random star in the galaxy explodes at the might of the old god's power._
~Inflict Rapture~.Name: ~Inflict Rapture~

~Divinity~.Effect: The Old God may become invisible, immaterial or teleport anywhere it wants, though its actions may seem difficult to understand. It may also cast any Basic Utility Ability (without spending {Mana}Mana).
~Divinity~.Name: ~Divinity~
